### **4.4 Permission Matrix** {#4.4-permission-matrix}

Full \= unrestricted   ·   Restricted \= conditions apply (see footnotes)   ·   No \= denied

Cross-checked against GMS\_ERD. Cells shaded green \= Full, amber \= Restricted, grey \= No.

#### **Revision Notes**

1\. Walk-in / no-account single-session sale (Section A/B, note \[41\]): the ERD requires every Order to reference exactly one Customer. Added an explicit "create a minimal guest Customer/Account" step for the Receptionist so this flow satisfies the ERD instead of silently bypassing it.

2\. Single-session purchase and Session→Subscription (Section B/C, note \[43\]): the ERD requires every Session to belong to exactly one Subscription. Clarified that both the counter walk-in sale and the "Book single session online" use case generate a 1-session Subscription, rather than leaving Session orphaned.

3\. Employee "basic information" vs. Person "Full Name/DOB" (Section A, note \[42\]): the two rows previously overlapped ambiguously. Scoped "basic information" explicitly to avatar/phone/email, leaving Full Name/DOB edits as Receptionist-only, consistent with the Person row.

4\. Manager leave requests (Section D, note \[44\]): the original matrix blocked Manager from submitting their own Leave Request with no alternate path. Added Manager as a Restricted submitter (approval routed to Admin) so every staff role has a documented way to request leave.

5\. No entities were missing from the original matrix — all 30 ERD entities (excluding cross-entity Report views) already had at least one row; this revision only tightens wording and closes the four gaps above.

### **5.2 External API Inventory** {#5.2-external-api-inventory}

\[Fill details of each external API into the table with the columns and sample data as below\] 

| \# | API Name | Calling Path | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | API-01: VNPay payment request | GMS → VNPay | Builds a signed VNPay 2.1.0 payment URL for one payment attempt of a Pending online order and redirects the customer's browser to the gateway; the link expires after 5 minutes, never beyond the order's payment deadline. |
| 2 | API-02: VNPay IPN webhook | VNPay → GMS | Receives the official payment result (GET /api/v1/commerce/payment/webhook/vnpay), verifies the signature and records the transaction; marks the order Paid only when it is still Pending and the amount matches. |
| 3 | API-03: Email delivery (SMTP) | GMS → Mail server | Sends 6-digit verification codes (SignUp, Claim, Recovery, EmailChange, PhoneChange) and the old-email notice when the login email changes, through SMTP port 587 with TLS. |
| 4 | API-04: Weather forecast (Open-Meteo) | GMS → Open-Meteo | Reads today's weather at the gym for the PT Dashboard; cached for 30 minutes; the weather card is hidden if unavailable. |

### **5.3 Background Job Inventory** {#5.3-background-job-inventory}

\[Fill details of each background job into the table with the columns and sample data as below\]

| \# | Job Name | Group | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | JOB-01: Resume expired membership freezes | Scheduled | Runs: daily at 00:05 (Asia/Ho\_Chi\_Minh), first in the daily chain. Threshold: freeze still in progress whose Planned End Date is before today. Result: package Frozen → Active; ActualEndDate − StartDate \+ 1 frozen days are added to the package End Date. |
| 2 | JOB-02: Expire membership and PT packages | Scheduled | Runs: daily, right after JOB-01. Threshold: package End Date is before today. Result: membership → Expired, a member with no valid package left → Expired; PT package → Expired and its leftover Scheduled sessions → Cancelled (PackageExpired, CBR-55). |
| 3 | JOB-03: Expire unused day passes | Scheduled | Runs: daily, right after JOB-02. Threshold: the pass's valid day has ended without a check-in. Result: day pass → Expired; a member with no valid package left → Expired. |
| 4 | JOB-04: Auto-close unmarked PT sessions | Scheduled | Runs: daily, right after JOB-03. Threshold: session still Scheduled more than 24 hours after its end time (P-07). Result: no valid membership for a PT-package session → Missed (NoMembership, evaluated first); customer checked in on the session day → Completed; otherwise → Missed (NoCheckIn). |
| 5 | JOB-05: Cancel overdue online orders | Scheduled | Runs: every minute. Threshold: online order still Pending past the payment deadline stored on the order (creation \+ P-09, default 20 minutes). Result: order → Cancelled (PaymentTimeout); Pending transactions → Expired; voucher use returned; Held slot → Free. |
| 6 | JOB-06: Expire timed-out payment transactions | Scheduled | Runs: every minute. Threshold: transaction still Pending past its own deadline — 5 minutes after its payment link is created, never beyond the order's deadline. Result: transaction → Expired; the order stays Pending so the customer can pay again. |
| 7 | JOB-07: Remind and auto-reject overdue leave requests | Scheduled | Runs: every minute. Threshold: approval cut-off of 20:00 on the day before the leave date (P-20). Result: Managers reminded before the cut-off; after it, request → Rejected and the staff member notified. |

# **II. Functional Requirements** {#ii.-functional-requirements}

## **1\. Authentication** {#1.-authentication}

### **1.1. Sign In**  {#1.1.-sign-in}

- Lets every user (customer, PT, receptionist, manager, admin) sign in with an email or phone number and a password. (UC-01)

![][image38]

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Email or phone number | Data type: string, required, max 100 characters. Accepts an email or a phone number. Email: must follow the format name@domain (e.g. an.nguyen@gmail.com). Phone number: exactly 10 digits, starts with 0\. If the phone number is used by both a customer and a staff account, the user must sign in with email. |
| Password | Data type: string, required, masked. No format check; only compared with the saved password. The eye icon shows or hides the password. |

### **1.2. Register Account** {#1.2.-register-account}

- Lets a guest create a customer account in two steps: check the phone number, then enter account details. (UC-05, UC-IDENT)

#### **1.2.1 Step 1: Phone Check**

- The guest enters a phone number so the system can check whether they already have a profile at the gym before creating an account. (UC-05, UC-IDENT)

####  **![][image39]**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Phone number | Data type: string, required, exactly 10 digits, starts with 0\.  Runs, no match goes to Step 2; an active self-owned profile without an account goes to the activation branch; a profile that already has an account stops. Guardian numbers of Dependent profiles are ignored. |

#### **1.2.2 Step 2: Account details (phone number not found)**

- Shown when the phone number is not found: the guest enters email, password, full name and date of birth to create a new customer account. (UC-05)

![][image40]

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Phone number | Read-only, the number checked in Step 1; changed only by going back to Step 1\. |
| Email | Data type: string, required, valid format (must follow the format name@domain), max 100 characters, not used by another active account.  A verification code is sent here before the account is created. |
| Password | Data type: string, required, masked, 6-64 characters; the eye icon toggles visibility. |
| Confirm password | Data type: string, required, masked, must match Password. |
| Full name | Data type: string, required, 2-50 characters; letters with Vietnamese diacritics, spaces, apostrophe, hyphen; trimmed. |
| Date of birth | Data type: date, required, displayed dd/mm/yyyy. Must not be in the future; age must not exceed 100\. Used to check the minimum age for PT services: under 10 cannot buy PT packages or book PT sessions. Cannot be changed by the customer after registration.  |

### **1.3. Forgot Password** {#1.3.-forgot-password}

- Lets any user reset a forgotten password through the registered email, in three steps. An account created at the counter that has no password yet uses the same three steps to set its first password. (UC-03, CBR-31) 

#### **1.3.1. Step 1 \- Enter Email**

- The user enters the registered email to receive a 6-digit recovery code. (UC-03)

![][image41]

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Email | Data type: string, required, max 100 characters. Must follow the format name@domain. Recovery goes only through the registered email, never the phone number. |

#### **1.3.2. Step 2 \- Enter Recovery Code**

- The user enters the recovery code sent by email; a new code can be requested if needed. (UC-03)

![][image42]

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Recovery code | Data type: string, required, exactly 6 digits. Valid for 15 minutes; a countdown shows the remaining time. After 5 wrong entries the code is cancelled and a new one must be requested. A new code can be requested after 60 seconds, at most 5 times per hour for one email. Requesting a new code cancels the previous one. |

#### **1.3.3. Step 3 \- Set New Password**

- The user sets a new password; all existing sessions are signed out. (UC-03)

![][image43]

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| New password | Data type: string, required, masked, 8-64 characters. The eye icon shows or hides the password. |
| Confirm new password | Data type: string, required, masked. Must match New password. A successful change signs out all existing sessions. |

### **1.4. Account Settings**  {#1.4.-account-settings}

- Lets a signed-in user view and update their own account information, in three tabs. (UC-04)

#### **1.4.1. Profile Tab**

- Shows the user's profile. The customer can change the avatar, email and phone number; information maintained by the front desk is view only. (UC-04)

![][image44]

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Avatar | Data type: image, optional, JPG or PNG, max 2 MB, from 200 x 200 to 2000 x 2000 px. Non-square images are cropped to the centre; stored and shown at 256 x 256 px. Display only, never used for check-in. Default: initials of the name. |
| Email | Data type: string, required, max 100 characters. Must follow the format name@domain and be unique among active accounts. A change is confirmed by a code sent to the new email. After the change, the old email is notified and all sessions are signed out. |
| Phone number | Data type: string, required, exactly 10 digits, starts with 0\. Checked for duplicates in the same way as when the profile was created. A change is confirmed by a code sent to the email. |
| Date of birth | Data type: date, read-only, displayed dd/mm/yyyy. Only the front desk can change it, together with full name, check-in photo and guardian. |

#### **1.4.2. Password Tab**

- Lets the user change the password by entering the current password and a new one. (UC-04)

![][image45]  
đang lỗi màn

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Current password | Data type: string, required, masked. Must match the saved password. |
| New password | Data type: string, required, masked, 8-64 characters. Must be different from the current password. |
| Confirm new password | Data type: string, required, masked. Must match New password. A successful change signs out all other sessions. |

#### **1.4.3. Dependent Profiles Tab**

- Shows the dependent profiles (e.g. children) linked to the customer's account; view only. (UC-04)

![][image46]

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Field Group \- Dependent Profile List** |  |
| Name | Data type: string, read-only. Full name of the dependent linked to this guardian. |
| Age | Data type: integer, read-only. Calculated from date of birth; under 10 cannot book PT sessions. |
| Customer code | Data type: string, read-only. Membership code of the dependent, generated by the system (e.g. SG-0242). |
| Package | Data type: string, read-only. Current membership package and expiry date (e.g. 3-month package, until 30/11/2026). The guardian cannot change anything on a dependent profile. |

## **2\. Public Pages** {#2.-public-pages}

### **2.1 Homepage** {#2.1-homepage}

#### 2.1.1 Homepage

![Mockup][image47]

![Mockup][image48]

![Mockup][image49]

![Mockup][image50]

This screen allows everyone visiting the gym's website, including Guests without an account (no sign-in required), to:

* Learn about the gym in general: facilities, services, the process for getting started, and the trainers.

* View the opening hours and the price list of the membership packages and personal trainer (PT) packages currently on sale.

* Read the latest Blog posts and the frequently asked questions.

The screen only displays information; it has no input fields.

On the screen, s/he can also:

* Register a new account, or sign in if he/she already has an account.

* Choose a membership package to register: a user who is not signed in is taken to register / sign in, then continues to purchase the selected package.

* Book a single PT session online after signing in.

* Go to the Blog screen to see all posts.

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Gym information** |  |
| Number of trainers | The actual number of PTs currently working at the gym. The system updates it automatically when a PT is added or leaves. |
| Opening hours | The gym's actual operating hours as configured by the manager. The system updates it automatically when the manager changes them. Also shown in the footer. |
| **Membership package list** |  |
| List content | The membership packages currently on sale, sorted from short-term to long-term. Data comes from the membership package catalogue configured by the manager; discontinued packages are not shown. If there is no package, a notice is displayed instead of the list. |
| Package name | Text. The package name as configured in the membership package catalogue. |
| Price | Amount (VND), VAT included, as configured for the package. |
| Duration | The duration of the package (for example 1, 3, 6, 12 months). |
| Equivalent monthly price | Calculated automatically by the system; shown only for packages longer than 1 month. |
| Saving | Calculated automatically by the system compared with the 1-month package; shown only when there is a saving. |
| Description and benefits | A short description and the list of benefits of the package, taken from the description entered by the manager. |
| Highlight label | A label marking the package that attracts the most interest and the package with the best saving; each label is attached to one package only. |
| **PT package list** |  |
| List content | The personal training packages currently on sale (single package, couple package, monthly package, package by number of sessions, single session). Data comes from the PT package catalogue configured by the manager; discontinued packages are not shown. |
| Package name | Text. The package name as configured in the PT package catalogue. |
| Price | Amount (VND), VAT included, as configured for the package. |
| Number of sessions | The number of training sessions in the package. |
| Number of people | 1 person, or 2 people for a couple package. |
| Description | A short description of the package. |
| Purchase method | Shows whether the package is registered at the front desk or booked online. Long-term PT packages are registered at the front desk; only a single session can be booked online, after signing in. |
| **Trainer list** |  |
| List content | Introduces a selection of featured trainers. Only PTs who are currently working are included; personal contact information is not shown. |
| Avatar | A circle containing the initials of the trainer's name (no real photo is used). |
| Full name | The trainer's full name. |
| Specialty | Text. The trainer's area of expertise. |
| Experience | Years of experience and number of sessions taught. For marketing purposes only; these are not real figures. |
| **Latest post list** |  |
| List content | Up to 3 of the newest published posts from the Blog. Select a post to see its details. If there are no posts, this section is hidden. |
| Cover image | The post's representative image, optional. A post without a cover image uses a default image based on its category. |
| Category | A label showing which category the post belongs to. |
| Title | The post title, 5–200 characters. |
| Excerpt | A short description of the post, optional, maximum 300 characters. A post without an excerpt uses the beginning of its content. |
| Publish date | The date the post was published, format dd/mm/yyyy. |

### **2.2 Public Blog** {#2.2-public-blog}

#### 2.2.1 Blog List

![Mockup][image51]

This screen allows everyone, including Guests who are not signed in, to view the list of posts on the gym's Blog (training knowledge, nutrition and news). Users can:

* Search posts by keyword and filter them by category.

* View the excerpt of each post and move between the pages of the list.

On the screen, s/he can also:

* Select a post to view its detailed content.

* Register a new account or sign in from the navigation bar.

Only published posts are displayed; posts that the manager has taken down disappear from the list.

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Search box | Data type: text, optional, maximum 100 characters; empty initially. Searches posts by title and excerpt, case-insensitive and diacritic-insensitive. If empty, all published posts are shown. |
| Category | Select one category to filter the posts. Initial values: All, Training, Nutrition, News (default "All"). Only one category can be selected. Combined with the search box: a post must satisfy both conditions. |
| **Post list** |  |
| List content | Published posts only, displayed as cards; the newest post comes first, 6 posts per page with pagination. The total number of posts matching the filters is shown above the list. When the keyword or category changes, the list returns to page 1\. If no post matches, a "no results" message is displayed. |
| Cover image | The post's representative image, optional. A post without a cover image uses a default image based on its category. |
| Category | A label showing which category the post belongs to. |
| Title | The post title, 5–200 characters, displayed on at most 2 lines. |
| Excerpt | A short description of the post, optional, maximum 300 characters, displayed on at most 3 lines. A post without an excerpt uses the beginning of its content. |
| Publish date | The date the post was published, format dd/mm/yyyy. |

#### 2.2.2 Blog Details

![Mockup][image52]

This screen allows everyone, including Guests who are not signed in, to read the full content of a post on the gym's Blog. Users can:

* View the full cover image, category, title, publish date, reading time and content of the post.

* View suggestions of other posts in the same category.

On the screen, s/he can also:

* Go back to the Blog list.

* Select a suggested post to keep reading.

* Register a new account or sign in from the navigation bar.

If the post has been taken down by the manager or does not exist, the screen does not display the post content; it only shows a short notice with a link back to the list.

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Post information** |  |
| Cover image | The large representative image of the post, optional. A post without a cover image uses a default image based on its category. |
| Category | A label showing which category the post belongs to (Training, Nutrition or News). |
| Title | The post title, 5–200 characters, displayed in full. |
| Publish date | The date the post was published, format dd/mm/yyyy. |
| Reading time | The estimated reading time of the post, calculated automatically by the system from the length of the content. |
| Content | The post content: formatted text, maximum 20,000 characters. Displayed with the formatting the manager authored (paragraphs, headings, lists, bold / italic, links, images). |
| **Same-category post list** |  |
| List content | Suggests up to 3 published posts in the same category, excluding the post being viewed; the newest come first. Select a post to go to it. If no suitable post exists, the whole section is hidden. |
| Cover image | The post's representative image, optional. A post without a cover image uses a default image based on its category. |
| Category | A label showing which category the post belongs to. |
| Title | The post title, 5–200 characters. |
| Excerpt | A short description of the post, optional, maximum 300 characters. A post without an excerpt uses the beginning of its content. |
| Publish date | The date the post was published, format dd/mm/yyyy. |

## **4\. Configuration & Sales Catalogue** {#4.-configuration-&-sales-catalogue}

### **4.1 Operating Parameters & Hours** {#4.1-operating-parameters-&-hours}

#### **4.1.1 Operating Parameters**

![][image61]

This screen allows Manager to:

•      View every operating parameter (P-01–P-21) together with its current value, unit of measure and a short description. 

•      Filter the list by setting type and by setting status to find a parameter quickly.

On the screen, s/he can also:

•      Open a parameter's row to change its value (leads to screen 4.1.2).

Relevant use cases:

•      UC-09: Manage Operating Parameters

 

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| (1) Setting Type filter | Data type: single select, optional. Initial values: the names of every active operating parameter, plus a blank/empty option meaning no filter is applied. This field has no permanent visible label on screen — hovering the mouse over it reveals the tooltip “Setting Type”. |
| (2) Setting Status filter | Remove the Setting Status filter and the Activate/Deactivate action. Parameters cannot be deactivated; every parameter always has exactly one current value stored in SystemConfigs (ConfigKey P-01…P-21).  |

**Screen-level notes:**

•      Each row's status can be switched directly from the list; the action shown reads “Deactivate” when the parameter is currently Active and “Activate” when it is currently Inactive.

•      The list must stay aligned one-to-one with the configuration keys defined in the system; any parameter not exposed on this screen is deployment-level configuration only.

 

#### **4.1.2 Edit Parameter**

![][image62]

This screen allows Manager to:

•      View and change the value of one operating parameter.

Relevant use cases:

•      UC-09: Manage Operating Parameters

 

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Parameter value** |  |
| Parameter name | Data type: string, read-only. Identifies which parameter is being edited. |
| Value (numeric parameters) | Data type: integer, required, must fall inside the minimum and maximum allowed for that specific parameter. P-02 Maximum freeze length is an integer number of calendar months, 1–12 (default 1); the last allowed freeze day is StartDate \+ P-02 months − 1 day (GBR-03), minimum PT on shift 1–10 people, VAT 0–20%, PT commission 0–100%, online payment deadline 5–120 minutes. |
| Value (time parameters) | Data type: time (HH:mm), required. The leave-approval cut-off time must be set later than the leave-submission cut-off time on the same day. |
| Unit / description | Data type: string, read-only. Helper text explaining where and how this parameter is applied. |

**Screen-level notes:**

•      Changing the online payment deadline only applies to orders created after the change; an order already in progress keeps the deadline that was in effect when it was created.

•      Every change is written to the audit log together with the old value and the new value.

 

#### **4.1.3 Operating Hours**

![][image63]

This screen allows Manager to:

•      Set the gym's default opening time and closing time for every day of the week.

•      Add an exception day (public holiday, special closure) with its own hours, or mark the whole day closed.

Relevant use cases:

•      UC-11: Manage Operating Hours

 

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Default hours** |  |
| Opening time | Data type: time (HH:mm), required. Applies to every day that has no exception. |
| Closing time | Data type: time (HH:mm), required, must be later than the opening time. |
| **Exception day** |  |
| Date | Data type: date, required, must be today or a future date, must be unique within the exception list. |
| Closed all day | Data type: yes/no toggle, default “no”. When set to “yes”, the opening and closing time fields below are disabled. |
| Opening time / Closing time | Data type: time, required when “Closed all day” is “no”; closing time must be later than opening time. |
| Note | Data type: string, optional, max 200 characters. Reason shown to staff, for example the name of the public holiday. |

**Screen-level notes:**

•      An exception day's hours apply instead of the default hours, for that date only.

•      PT slot declaration, PT package sessions, single-session booking and member check-in must fall inside the hours configured here (GBR-11). Buying a package online is not restricted by operating hours. 

•      The two daily work shifts used for receptionist and PT scheduling are generated automatically from these hours; there is no separate shift-planning screen.

#### **4.2.2 Membership Package Form**

Relevant use cases:

It is stored as DurationUnit (Day or Month) and DurationValue. A day pass is always 1 Day; a membership package is always in months. The end date is computed by calendar month (start.plusMonths(n)), last day inclusive, never as 30 days (GBR-03). |

**Screen-level notes:**

•      Changing the price or the description of a package never changes orders that were already created before the change.

•      Setting a package to Inactive stops it from being sold to new customers; orders already running on it are not affected.

#### **4.2.4 PT Package Form**

This screen allows Manager to:

| Field Name | Description |

The real number of sessions is generated from the term and the Monday-to-Friday calendar when the order is Paid (BR-40, DBR-53), and the session value is computed from that real number (DBR-59).  |
| Validity period | Data type: integer, number of days, required. Duration: required, single select from parameter P-21 (default 1, 2, 3 months), stored as DurationUnit \= Month and DurationValue. The term runs from the start date chosen at sale to start.plusMonths(n), last day inclusive (BR-40, GBR-03).  |

#### **4.3.2 Voucher Form**

![][image69]

This screen allows Manager to:

•      Create a new discount voucher or edit an existing one.

Relevant use cases:

•      UC-12: Manage Vouchers

 

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Code & value** |  |
| Voucher code | Data type: string, required, 4–20 characters, uppercase letters and digits only, unique across all vouchers. Cannot be changed once the voucher has been used at least once. |
| Discount type | Data type: required. Values: Percentage or Fixed amount. |

•      Editing a voucher's conditions never changes orders that already carry that voucher code.

•      The used count is maintained automatically by the system: it increases by one when the voucher is applied to an order, and decreases by one when it is removed from an order or the order is cancelled.

#### **5.1.2 Staff Details**

#### **![][image71]**

This screen allows Manager to:

•     The Manager opens a staff member's profile to view or edit personnel details or to record a resignation. New staff members are created only by the Admin (UC-07, CBR-95). 

Relevant use cases:

•      UC-13: Manage Staff Profiles

 

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Personal information** |  |
| Full name | Data type: string, required, 2–50 characters. Letters including Vietnamese diacritics, spaces, apostrophe and hyphen only; digits and other symbols are rejected. |
| Date of birth | Data type: date (dd/mm/yyyy), required, must not be a future date. |
| Phone number and Email | Phone number and email: read-only on this screen. They are stored on Person, unique among active Persons (staff and customers alike), and are changed only by the staff member in Account Settings with a verification code (CBR-110).  |
| **Employment information** |  |
| Position | Data type: required. Values: Manager, PT, Receptionist. Changing a staff member's position is blocked while they still have unfinished work in the current one — for example a PT with scheduled sessions, future available slots or a running PT package, or a receptionist with an open shift. Position: read-only on this screen. Only the Admin changes an employee's position (UC-07), and only when no unfinished work remains in the old position (CBR-87, BR-08).  |
| Start date | Data type: date, required, must not be a future date. |
| Commission rate | Data type: integer percentage, 0–100. Shown only when Position is PT. |
| **Resignation** |  |
| Resignation date | Data type: date, required only when recording a resignation, must not be earlier than the start date. |
| Reason | Data type: string, required, 5–500 characters. |

**Screen-level notes:**

•      Recording a resignation sets Employees.Status \= Resigned with the resignation time and reason, and signs out every session of the Person's account (CBR-86). If the Person still has a customer profile that is not Inactive, the account stays Active and serves only the Customer role; otherwise the account becomes Inactive and the phone number and email are released (Persons.IsReleased \= 1, DBR-28). The last active Admin cannot be set to Resigned (BR-07). 

•      A resigned staff member disappears from the default “Working” list, but the employment history is kept.

## **6\. Customer Management** {#6.-customer-management}

### **6.1 Customer Profile** {#6.1-customer-profile}

#### 6.1.1 Customer Profile List (Receptionist)

![][image76]

This screen allows the Receptionist to:

* View the list of all customer profiles created in the system, including customers who have purchased a package (members) and customers who have not.

* Search for a profile by name, phone number, or customer code.

* Filter the list by profile status and by the type of membership package currently in use.

On the screen, the Receptionist can also:

* Clear the search/filter conditions currently applied to view the full list again.

* Open the Create New Customer Profile screen.

* Select a profile in the list to open the Create/Edit Customer Profile screen and update information.

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Field group: Filter / Search** |  |
| Search box | Data type: string, optional. Allows entering a name, phone number, or customer code to quickly find a profile in the list. |
| Status | Status: single select, default All. Values: All, New, Active, Frozen, Expired. Inactive (deleted) profiles are never shown to the Receptionist (CBR-04).  |
| Package | A dropdown to filter profiles by the type of membership package the customer is using. |
| “Clear filters” button | Resets the search and filter conditions to default, displaying the full profile list again. |
| **Field group: Results list** |  |
| List data | Each row represents one customer profile, showing customer code, name, phone number, current package with its expiry date, and profile status; profiles with a pending deletion request are marked separately. The list supports pagination when there are many results. |

On the screen, the Receptionist can also:

#### 7.1.1 Purchase Package(Customer)

![][image87]

This screen allows **Customers** to: 

* **View package list:** View gym packages and single-day passes currently available for online purchase, including pricing, validity duration, and discount/savings rates. 

* **Search packages:** Enter keywords to search packages by name. 

* **Filter and sort packages:** Filter by package type; sort by duration or price. 

* **Select package:** Create an order in "Pending Payment" status and navigate to the Payment screen. 

On this screen, customers can also: 

* **Clear filters:** Reset filters to default values. 

* **View current package expiry date:** (Only displayed if the customer currently has an active package). 

Notes: 

* Displayed prices are final amounts payable by the customer (VAT included). 

* PT (Personal Trainer) packages cannot be purchased online and are only available at the front desk; therefore, they are not displayed on this screen. 

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Filters** |  |
| Search Package | String, optional, max 100 characters, auto-trim leading/trailing whitespaces. Searches by package name, case-insensitive and Vietnamese diacritics-insensitive. Leaving it blank means no filter.  |
| Type | default: **All**. Values: All, Gym Package, Day Pass. |
| Sort by | Single-select dropdown, default: **Duration: Ascending**. Values: Duration: Ascending, Price: Low to High, Price: High to Low. |

Each card displays: package name, VAT-inclusive price, duration (days or months), short description, and savings rate (%). • Only shows active packages; packages switched to inactive/discontinued will disappear from the list. • Savings rate is only displayed for packages of 3 months or more. • Highlight badges **"Most Popular"** and **"Best Value"** are assigned by the system (one package per badge). The "Most Popular" card has an emphasized border and button. • If no package matches filters: display a "No suitable packages found" message.  |
| Select Package | Action button on each card. • Generates a new order in **Pending Payment** status (capturing package name, description, and price at creation time), then redirects to the Payment screen for that order. • If the customer already has an existing pending order for the same package, the old order will be canceled. • If the customer holds a valid unexpired package, the new package's validity will start the day after the current package expires.  |

#### 

#### 7.1.2 Payment

![][image88]

This screen allows **Customers** to: 

* **Review selected package:** Review package details and order summary. 

* **Apply discount code:** Enter a promotional/discount code to receive a discount on the order. 

* **Make payment:** Complete payment via the online payment gateway within the order payment window. 

On this screen, customers can also: 

1. Remove or replace an applied discount code. 

2. Retry payment if the transaction fails. 

3. Return to the "Purchase Package" screen to choose a different package. 

The screen has 4 states: 

1. **Pending Payment** (as shown in UI): Countdown timer is running. When no transaction is pending, users can enter, apply, or remove discount codes, and the "Pay" button is enabled. Once "Pay" is clicked, the promo code input and "Apply" button are locked until transaction results are returned. 

2. **Success:** Order status changes to **Paid**, system provisions the package for the member (New or Expired member status updates to Active). The countdown timer is hidden, all inputs are locked, package details, start/end dates, and a navigation link to Transaction History are displayed. 

3. **Failed:** Gateway reports an error, card declined, customer cancels at the gateway, or payment session expires. Order remains in **Pending Payment**, countdown timer continues running; displays failure reason, re-enables promo code input, and displays a "Retry Payment" button. 

4. **Expired:** Countdown reaches 00:00 without successful payment. Order automatically updates to **Canceled**, the consumed voucher usage quota is returned. All inputs and the payment button are disabled; an expiration notification is shown along with a button to return to "Purchase Package". 

Notes: 

* If funds are received for a canceled order or with an incorrect amount: transaction is still logged as Success, but privileges/memberships are **not** granted, and the record is flagged in the Manager's refund queue. Refunds are processed externally/manually. 

* This screen only displays order info; it does not issue official tax invoices. 

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Selected Package (Read-only)** |  |
| Package Information | Read-only. Includes package name, description, duration from activation date, VAT-inclusive price (data snapshot saved at order creation). Cannot be edited. To change packages, the customer must return to the "Purchase Package" screen to create a new order. |
| **Voucher** |  |
| Voucher Code | String, optional, 4–20 characters, uppercase alphanumeric only (auto-converted to uppercase upon typing). Maximum 1 code per order. • Validation errors displayed below input: code does not exist, expired, out of quota, already redeemed by this customer, minimum order value not met, or not applicable to this package. • When applied successfully: Order summary adds a discount row; code can be removed or swapped (returns 1 usage back to the old code). • Disabled when a transaction is pending, or when order state is Success or Expired. |
| **Checkout** |  |
| Method | Single-select (radio button), mandatory. Value: **Online Payment Gateway** (Domestic cards, international cards, e-wallets). Pre-selected by default and cannot be changed |
| **Order Summary & Pay** |  |
| Countdown Timer | Read-only, mm:ss format. Counts down to the order expiration deadline (configurable, e.g., 20 minutes; deadline captured at order creation). Switches to Expired state at 00:00. Hidden in Success state. |
| Message | Notification regarding the validity period of the payment link. |
| Order Summary | Order summary: Package price (VAT included), Discount (only if a voucher is applied), Amount payable \= price − discount, of which VAT x% \= Amount payable × x ÷ (100 \+ x) rounded to the dong, and Pre-tax amount \= Amount payable − VAT. x is the VAT rate copied into the order at creation (P-10, Orders.VatRateSnapshot); the VAT amount is stored on the order (DBR-57).  |
| Pay  | Action button displaying the total payable amount. Opens payment gateway and initiates a pending transaction (only 1 pending transaction allowed at a time). Enabled during Pending Payment and Failed states (while order is unexpired); disabled in Success and Expired states. |

### **7.2 Counter Sales**  {#7.2-counter-sales}

#### 7.2.1 Gym Package Sales

![][image89]

This screen allows the **Receptionist** to: 

* **Select customer:** Search for an existing customer or quickly register a new customer profile. 

* **Select package:** Choose an active gym package or single-day pass. 

* **Apply voucher:** Enter a voucher code for the order. 

* **Make payment:** Select payment method (Cash or Bank Transfer) and finalize the order. 

On this screen, users can also: 

* View the order summary in the right-hand column. 

* View a reference list of vouchers and click on any row to auto-populate the input field. 

Notes: 

1. Receptionist must be logged in with an active working shift open; all revenues will be attributed to the currently open shift. 

2. **Cash payment:** Order becomes **Paid** immediately, logging a successful transaction to the shift. 

3. **Bank transfer:** Order remains in **Pending Payment** status, displayed on the Shift Management screen for receptionist confirmation upon verifying incoming bank account balance; status transitions to **Paid** only after confirmation. 

4. Once **Paid**: Member status transitions from New or Expired to Active and check-in privileges are granted. 

5. Single-day passes do not require a check-in photo and expire immediately after the first check-in. Packages of 1 month or more require a face photo captured at the counter prior to the first entry (photos are not taken on this sales screen)

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Step 1 — Customer** |  |
| Search Customer | String, optional, max 100 characters. Searches by customer name, phone number, or customer code; case and diacritics insensitive.  |
| Customer List | Each row shows the profile status badge: New, Active, Frozen or Expired. |
| **Step 2 — Gym Package** |  |
| Package | Single selection from cards, mandatory. Day passes are listed together. • Each card: package name, duration, VAT-inclusive price, savings rate (only for packages ≥ 3 months). • Only active packages are displayed. • Changing package updates Order Summary; if a voucher was applied, conditions are re-evaluated; if criteria are not met, voucher is removed and an alert is shown. |
| **Step 3 — Voucher** |  |
| Voucher Code | String, optional, 4–20 characters, uppercase alphanumeric only. Max 1 code per order. Validates on apply: validity period, total usage quota, customer redemption limit, package applicability, minimum order value. Error displays specific rejection reason. (Day passes have lower price points and may not meet minimum spend requirements for certain vouchers). |
| Reference Voucher List | Read-only. Each row: voucher code and conditions (discount rate, minimum spend), or reason why unavailable (expired on date X, already used by customer). Clicking a row fills the voucher code into the input field. |
| **Step 4 — Payment** |  |
| Payment Method | Single selection, mandatory, default: **Cash**. • **Cash:** recorded directly to shift, reconciled at shift close. • **Bank Transfer:** marked as paid only after receptionist verifies the balance fluctuation in the gym's bank account.  |
| **Order Summary** |  |
| Order Summary | Read-only. Contains Customer, Package, Package Price, Discount (only if voucher applied), Price excl. VAT, VAT 8% (included), Total Due. Displays 0 if nothing is selected. |

#### 7.2.2 PT Package Sales ![][image90]

![][image91]

This screen allows the Receptionist to sell a personal training (PT) package to a customer at the counter:

•         Select customer: find and select an eligible customer (plus a second customer for a duo package).

•         Select package type: a monthly single package, a monthly duo package, or a single session for today.

•         Select personal trainer (PT): select the PT in charge.

•       Start date and fixed slot: the Receptionist picks the start date and one fixed time slot that the customer agreed with the PT and that is one of the PT's published available slots (CBR-52). The system generates one session at that time on every Monday-to-Friday from the start date to the end date (BR-40, CBR-43), skips declared closed days (CBR-56), and lists the dates where the fixed slot is taken so the Receptionist can pick another free slot of the same PT for those dates only, or leave them without a session (BR-41). Saturday and Sunday are never used (BR-35, BR-36). Remove "Repeat current week" and "Clear current week”.

•         Make payment: choose Cash or Bank Transfer and complete the order.

On the screen, the user can also:

•         Review the PT package order (customer, package type, PT, selected sessions, price) in the right-hand column before completing the order.

•         Move between weeks ("Previous week" / "Next week"), or jump back to the first week of the package.

•         Repeat the sessions selected in the current week into the following weeks, or clear all selections in the current week.

Notes:

•         PT packages are sold only at the counter, never online. The receptionist must be signed in with an open shift.

•         The date and session section only opens once the customer, package type and PT have been selected. Changing the package type or the PT clears all selected sessions.

•         Cash payment: the order is marked Paid immediately. Bank transfer: it waits for the receptionist to confirm the payment on the Shift Management screen.

•         Once paid, the system schedules every session as Scheduled and reserves the corresponding slots on the PT's calendar.

•         After payment, each session can be swapped individually up to the swap limit copied at sale (P-08, default 3, Subscriptions.MaxSwapsSnapshot — BR-73). The package ends on start date \+ package duration in months, last day inclusive (BR-40, GBR-03); Scheduled sessions left after the end date become Cancelled with CancelType PackageExpired (CBR-55). 

•         A PT package does not include gym facility access: the customer must still hold an active gym membership. Vouchers do not apply to PT packages or single sessions.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Step 1 — Customer** |  |
| Search box | Text, optional, maximum 100 characters. Searches by name, phone number or customer ID, case- and diacritic-insensitive. |
| Customer list | Select one row, required. Each row shows the name, customer ID, phone number, current membership package with its expiry (or "No package"), and an Eligible / Ineligible label; an ineligible row is still shown but cannot be selected. |
| Second customer | Select one, required, shown only when the selected package type is a duo package. Must meet the same eligibility as the first customer and cannot be the same person. |
| **Step 2 — Package Type** |  |
| Package type | Select one card, required, no default selection. The source is the PT packages currently on sale (single package, duo package, single session today). Each card shows the name, a short description and the VAT-inclusive price. Changing the package type clears all sessions selected in Step 4\. |
| **Step 3 — Personal Trainer** |  |
| PT list | PT list: each row shows the PT's name and specialty; only PTs with employment status Working are listed. The customer chooses the PT (BR-39); there is no client capacity limit (BR-50). If the customer is also an employee PT, their own Person is not listed (CBR-59, CBR-115).  |
| **Step 4 — Select Start Date and Sessions** |  |
| Package start date | Date, required. Once selected, the system automatically calculates the package's date range based on the chosen package type. |
| Package date range | Read-only. Shows the package's date range, calculated from the start date. |
| Current week | Read-only. Shows the date range of the week being viewed and the number of sessions selected in that week. |
| Week navigation | Moves to the previous or the next week; includes a shortcut back to the first week of the package. |
| PT schedule grid | A weekly calendar grid, 7 columns from Monday to Sunday by time slot, scrollable to view further weeks. Only open slots on the PT's schedule can be selected; Saturday and Sunday are shown but cannot be selected; each weekday (Monday to Friday) allows only one selected session. Selecting the full number of sessions in the package is not required before payment. |
| Repeat current week | Action button. Duplicates the sessions selected in the current week into the following weeks. |
| Clear current week | Action button. Clears all sessions selected in the current week. |
| **Step 5 — Payment** |  |
| Payment method | Select one, required: Cash or Bank Transfer. PT packages have no online payment option. |
| Amount due | Read-only, equal to the order's total amount. PT packages do not accept vouchers, so there is no promo code field. |

Contains the customer (plus the second customer for a duo package), package type, PT, selected sessions, Order summary: customer (and partner for a couple package), package, PT, fixed slot, term (start date to end date), number of generated sessions, package price, Amount payable, VAT included (DBR-57). , package price, price excluding VAT, VAT (included), and total amount. |

### **7.3 Work Shift** {#7.3-work-shift}

#### 7.3.1 Shift Management (Open Shift / Close Shift / Void Transaction)

![][image92]

This screen allows the **On-duty Receptionist** to: 

* **Open shift:** Start assigned scheduled work shift. 

* **View shift metrics:** Monitor cash, bank transfer totals, total revenue, and pending orders. 

* **View and filter shift transactions:** Search by invoice ID or customer name, filter by payment method and status. 

* **Confirm bank transfers:** Confirm pending bank transfer orders after checking incoming payments. 

* **Cancel order:** the Receptionist may cancel a Pending counter order, or a Paid counter order created in the current shift before the shift is closed; the money is returned at the counter (CBR-11). The order becomes Cancelled with CancelType CancelledByReceptionist and the reason (5–500 characters); its voucher use is returned (BR-44), its slots return to Free (DBR-36), and the subscription created by it becomes Cancelled. Online orders cannot be cancelled here. A Receptionist cannot cancel an order of their own customer profile (CBR-115). 

* **Close shift:** Reconcile cash drawer and close shift. 

On this screen, users can also: 

* Clear filters to reset transaction filters to defaults. 

* Paginate through shift transactions. 

The screen has 3 states: 

1. **Shift Not Opened:** Top panel shows "Open Shift" button, metrics are zeroed out. Counter sales screens cannot finalize orders until shift is opened. 

2. **Shift Active/Open** (as shown in UI): All invoices generated from opening time are tied to this shift. Enables transfer confirmation, order cancellation, filtering, and closing the shift. 

3. **Reconciliation & Shift Closing:** Cash reconciliation modal opens upon clicking "Close Shift". Once confirmed, shift moves to **Closed**: read-only, no orders can be voided, metrics cannot be edited. 

Notes: 

* Each day has two shifts (Morning, Afternoon) pre-generated based on operating hours; no manual shift rostering is performed here. 

* Amounts are VAT-inclusive. Canceled orders and pending orders are excluded from totals. Only cash is reconciled at shift close. 

* Closed shift data is transferred to the Manager's Closed Shift History.

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Shift Control** |  |
| Open Shift | Visible only when current shift has not been opened. Records opening staff and timestamp; from this point, all counter collections are attributed to this shift. |
| Close Shift | Opens cash reconciliation dialog. Disabled if there are pending orders; each pending order must be confirmed or canceled first. |
| **Shift Metrics** |  |
| Cash | Read-only. Total amount and count of valid cash invoices. |
| Bank Transfer | Read-only. Total amount and count of valid bank transfer invoices.  |
| Total Revenue | Read-only. Total amount and count of valid invoices across both payment methods. |
| Pending Orders | Read-only. Number of unconfirmed bank transfer orders. Metrics update immediately following any action. |
| **Pending Transfer Orders (Alert Banner)** |  |
| Pending Order Info | Read-only. Invoice ID of pending bank transfer order. If multiple exist, displayed sequentially or by count. |
| **Shift Transaction Filters** |  |
| Search | String, optional, max 100 characters. Matches invoice ID or customer name; case and diacritics insensitive. |
| Method | Single-select dropdown, default: **All**. Values: All, Cash, Bank Transfer. |
| Status | Single-select dropdown, default: **All**. Values: All, Valid (Paid), Pending Confirmation, Canceled. |
| **Shift Transactions List** |  |
| Transactions | Each row: invoice ID, customer name, creation time, package, method (badge), amount. • Canceled orders: Canceled badge, strikethrough amount, cancellation reason displayed; excluded from all totals. • Pending confirmation: pending status badge. • Displays only current shift transactions; sorted newest first. |
| **Void Transaction** |  |
| Cancel order  | the Receptionist may cancel a Pending counter order, or a Paid counter order created in the current shift before the shift is closed; the money is returned at the counter (CBR-11). The order becomes Cancelled with CancelType CancelledByReceptionist and the reason (5–500 characters); its voucher use is returned (BR-44), its slots return to Free (DBR-36), and the subscription created by it becomes Cancelled. Online orders cannot be cancelled here. A Receptionist cannot cancel an order of their own customer profile (CBR-115).  |
| **Cash Reconciliation** |  |
| System Cash | Read-only. Total valid cash calculated by system for the shift. |
| Counted Cash | Integer, VND, mandatory, non-negative, no decimals, thousands separator displayed. Entered prior to closing. |
| Discrepancy | Simply read the data; the system calculates automatically. Negative numbers indicate a deficit, while positive numbers indicate a surplus. |
| Reason for Discrepancy | String, 5–500 characters; required when the difference is non-zero. |

### **7.4 Transactions** {#7.4-transactions}

#### 7.4.1 Transaction History (Customer)

![][image93]

This screen allows **Customers** to: 

* **View order list:** View their own orders (gym packages, day passes, single PT sessions) with status, total amount, and VAT. 

* **Search orders:** Enter keywords to search by order ID or package name. 

* **Filter orders:** Filter by time range and status. 

* **View order details:** Open details modal to inspect transaction attempts for an order. 

On this screen, customers can also: 

* Clear filters to restore default settings. 

* Paginate through orders list. 

Notes: 

* Screen is read-only; customers only see their own orders; canceled orders remain visible. Does not export/issue official invoices. 

* Total amount is inclusive of VAT; VAT amount displayed reflects the embedded portion within the total. 

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Filters** |  |
| Search | String, optional, max 100 characters. Matches order ID or package name; case and diacritics insensitive. |
| Time Range | Single-select dropdown, default: **All**. Values: All, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, Last 3 Months, Custom Date Range. Selecting Custom Date Range displays two date inputs: From Date and To Date (both mandatory, From Date ≤ To Date).  |
| Status | Single-select dropdown, default: **All**. Values: All, Paid, Pending Payment, Canceled. |
| **Order List** |  |
| Order Item | Each row: package name (or single PT session with date), status badge, order ID, creation date, VAT amount, VAT-inclusive total. Sorted newest first. Includes both online purchases and counter orders created by receptionists. Displays "No results found" if no match. |
| **Order Details** |  |
| Order Details | Order ID, creation timestamp, package details (name and description as at purchase time), subtotal excl. VAT, VAT, total payable, discount and applied voucher code, status. Canceled orders display Cancelled orders show the cancellation type: payment deadline passed (PaymentTimeout), replaced by a new order (ReplacedByNewOrder), invalid payment (InvalidPayment) or cancelled by the Receptionist (CancelledByReceptionist), with the reason when there is one.  |
| Payment Attempts | List of individual payment attempts for the order: timestamp, payment method, amount, status (Success, Failed, Pending, Expired). |

#### 7.4.2 System-wide Transactions (Manager)

![][image94]

This screen allows the **Manager** to: 

* **View orders and transactions:** Look up all orders and transactions across the entire system (both online and counter). 

* **Search and filter:** Search by order ID or customer name; filter by payment method, status, and date range. 

* **Track transactions requiring refund:** Filter successful payments that failed to provision membership privileges. 

* **View closed shifts history:** Review cash reconciliation data of closed shifts. 

* **Export data:** Export filtered records to Excel. 

On this screen, users can also: 

* Switch between two tabs: **Orders & Transactions** and **Closed Shift History**. 

* Click any order row to view transaction history details. 

Notes: 

* Entire screen is read-only: no edit, cancel, or refund operations. No date range search limitations. 

* Canceled orders are excluded from revenue; if funds were captured, they appear with a **"Refund Required"** badge. Refunds are processed outside the system. 

* All amounts displayed are inclusive of VAT. 

**Field Description**

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Tab** |  |
| Tab | Single select, default: **Orders & Transactions**. Values: Orders & Transactions, Closed Shift History |
| **Filters (Orders & Transactions Tab)** |  |
| Method | Single-select dropdown, default: **All Methods**. Values: All Methods, Cash, Bank Transfer, Payment Gateway. |
| Status | Single-select dropdown, default: **All Statuses**. Values: All Statuses, Paid, Pending Payment, Canceled. |
| Successful transactions requiring refund | Checkbox, default: unchecked; includes a counter badge showing pending refund counts. When checked, filters only successful payments where no privilege was granted: funds received for canceled orders, incorrect amounts, or PT slots already booked by another user during checkout. |
| Date Range (From – To) | Date pair, optional; From Date must be ≤ To Date |
| Search | String, optional, max 100 characters. Matches order ID or customer name. |
| **Orders & Transactions List** |  |
| Order Item | Each row: order ID with sales channel badge (Counter or Online), timestamp, customer name, package (with voucher code used, if any), total amount, VAT amount included, payment method, status.  Status: single badge (Paid, Pending Payment, Canceled); The secondary badge "Refund required" appears on a Cancelled order that has a Success transaction with NeedsRefund \= 1 and no refund recorded; after the refund is recorded it shows "Refunded" with date, Manager and note.   where payment was collected without granting benefits. Sorted newest first. Paginated when records exceed page size. |
| Order Details | Read-only. Identical to customer order details (order info, voucher, discount, cancellation reason and type, payment attempts with statuses), plus sales channel and refund notes. |
| **Closed Shift History Tab** |  |
| Date Range (From – To) | Date pair, optional. |
| Closed Shifts List | Read-only. Each row: date and shift name, on-duty receptionist, opening and closing timestamps, system cash, counted cash, discrepancy and reason, total bank transfer, total invoice count. |

### **9.2.3 Book Single Session** {#9.2.3-book-single-session}

![][image105]

This screen allows Customer to:

•  	Pick a trainer and a free slot for a single PT session.

•  	Pay for the session online to hold the slot.

On the screen, s/he can also:

•  	Narrow the trainer list by specialty and by time band.

Relevant use cases:

•  	UC-37: Book A Single Session With A PT

•  	UC-PAY: Process Payment & Record Transaction

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Trainer** |  |
| Trainer | A required dropdown to choose a trainer, narrowed by the selected specialty and time band . |
| **Slot** |  |
| Time band | Filters slots by time of day — All, Morning, Afternoon or Evening. Defaults to All. . |
| Slot | A required dropdown of free slots. Only slots the trainer has published are shown; a slot still in draft never appears in the calendar. Selectable days are limited to the current week, plus the following week from Saturday onwards. A day on which the customer has no valid membership package is shown but disabled, with the reason; a customer holding only a day pass can select today only.   |
| **Payment** |  |
| Payment | Paid immediately through the payment gateway; When the customer confirms, the system creates a Pending order and the slot becomes Held immediately for the order's payment deadline (P-09, default 20 minutes, shown as an mm:ss countdown — GBR-27). When the order is Paid the slot becomes Booked and the session is created; if the deadline passes unpaid, the order is Cancelled and the slot returns to Free. A Failed or Expired transaction keeps the slot Held while the order is still within its deadline (CBR-40, CBR-69). . Uses the same payment fields as the Checkout / Payment screen.  |

 

**Screen-level notes:**

•  	A customer who cannot use the gym's services (no valid membership package or day pass) cannot book; a customer below the minimum age for PT services is refused.

•  	When two customers book the same slot, the later booking is rejected.

•  	If the slot is taken while a payment is in progress, the transaction stays successful but no session is created, and the payment goes to the refund list.

 

### **9.2.4 Swap Session** {#9.2.4-swap-session}

![][image106]

This screen allows Customer to:

•  	View the session to be moved and how many swaps remain for the package.

On the screen, s/he can also:

•  	Narrow the list of new slots by time band.

Relevant use cases:

•  	UC-38: Reschedule A Session In A PT Package

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Current session (read-only)** |  |
| Session data | Date, time and trainer of the session being moved, plus the number of swaps still allowed for the package the number of swaps still allowed for the package (MaxSwapsSnapshot − SwapsUsed; the limit is P-08, default 3, copied into the package when sold — GBR-04, BR-73). . A single session cannot be swapped. |
| **New slot** |  |
| Time band | Filters slots by time of day — All, Morning, Afternoon or Evening. Defaults to All.  |
| New slot | A required dropdown limited to Saturday and Sunday slots — weekdays are shown but disabled. Limited to the current week, plus the following week from Saturday onwards. Only slots inside the trainer's published availability are offered, and only on days on which the customer still has a valid membership package.  |

 

**Screen-level notes:**

•  	The swap is one atomic transaction: releasing the old slot and taking the new one either both succeed or both are rolled back.

•  	Either member of a couple package may swap, without the other member's confirmation.

•  	When the swap allowance of the package is used up, the form is locked.

 

## **9.3 Time Slots & Attendance** {#9.3-time-slots-&-attendance}

### **9.3.1 Available Time Slots** {#9.3.1-available-time-slots}

![][image107]![][image108]

This screen allows PT to:

•  	View their own time slots of a chosen week, in calendar or list view.

•  	Declare many slots at once by giving a time range.

•  	Publish or discard the changes made to the week.

On the screen, s/he can also:

•  	Remove a slot.

•  	Open the screen for adding one single slot (leads to screen 9.3.2).

Relevant use cases:

•  	UC-30: Declare Available Time Slots

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Week navigation** |  |
| Week | The week being managed, defaulting to the current one. Any future week can be chosen without limit; past weeks are read-only.  |
| View mode | Switches the layout between Calendar and List view. Defaults to Calendar. . |
| **Bulk declaration** |  |
| From time | The start of the range, in hh:mm and snapped to 15-minute marks. Required, must fall inside that day's opening hours, and must be earlier than the To time.  |
| To time | The end of the range, in hh:mm. Required, must fall inside that day's opening hours, and must be later than the From time. . |
| Gap between slots | An optional gap in minutes (0 or more, default 0\) left between the slots generated one after another across the range  |
| **Publish** |  |
| Publish changes | Action only, no input. Draft slots and slots marked for removal become visible to customers only after publishing. |
| Discard changes | Action only, no input. Drops every unpublished change of the week. |
| Remove slot | Action only, no input. A slot that already has a booking cannot be removed until that session has been handled. |

 

**Screen-level notes:**

•  	Every slot lasts exactly P-06 minutes (default 90; one slot \= one session — DBR-20); EndTime \= StartTime \+ P-06. Duration is read-only and shows the current P-06 value. 

•  	The number of slots per day is decided by the PT; the system sets no limit.

 

### **9.3.2 Add Time Slot** {#9.3.2-add-time-slot}

This screen allows PT to:

•  	Add one single time slot on a chosen date.

Relevant use cases:

•  	UC-30: Declare Available Time Slots

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Slot** |  |
| Date | A required date, in dd/mm/yyyy, that must be in the future; any future date can be chosen without limit.  |
| Start time | A required start time, in hh:mm and snapped to 15-minute marks. The whole slot must fall inside the opening hours of that date, including any exceptional opening hours.  |
| Duration | Every slot lasts exactly P-06 minutes (default 90; one slot \= one session — DBR-20); EndTime \= StartTime \+ P-06. Duration is read-only and shows the current P-06 value.  |

 

**Screen-level notes:**

•  	A slot that overlaps an existing one is rejected, and the conflicting time is shown.

•  	A new slot stays a draft until it is published on screen 9.3.1.

 

### **9.3.3 Session Attendance** {#9.3.3-session-attendance}

![][image109]

![][image110]![][image111]![][image112]

This screen allows PT to:

•  	Look up their sessions by date and shift.

•  	Mark the customers who are absent, and confirm several sessions in one action.

•  	Handle a session they cannot teach: reschedule it, transfer it to another PT, or cancel it.

On the screen, s/he can also:

•  	Reschedule a session at the customer's request, for customers without an account.

•  	Verify the guardian's phone number before acting on behalf of a Dependent profile.

Relevant use cases:

•  	UC-31: Mark Session No-Show

•  	UC-35: Handle A Session Cancelled By A PT

| Field Name | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Filter bar** |  |
| Date | A required date, in dd/mm/yyyy, defaulting to today.  |
| Shift | Filters sessions by shift — All, Morning or Afternoon. Defaults to All.  |
| **Attendance** |  |
| Absent checkbox | A per-session checkbox, unchecked by default (meaning the customer is present). Several sessions can be confirmed in one action; marking a session absent still counts it as used, with no refund. Available from the session start time until P-07 hours (default 24\) after the session ends (BR-54). Marking absent sets the session to Missed with MissedReason \`MarkedAbsent\` (or \`NoMembership\` when the customer — couple: both members — holds no valid membership that day, CBR-64) and AttendanceMarkedAt; the session is deducted, not refunded, and still earns commission (BR-55, CBR-80  — past that window the system closes the session itself based on the customer's check-in history; for a couple package it can be ticked only when both members are absent, since one member attending is enough for the session to count as Completed.  |
| **Session the PT cannot teach** |  |
| Reschedule — new slot | Required when this option is chosen: a dropdown of the PT's own free slots. The session stays Scheduled and no session is consumed. Required when this option is chosen: a dropdown of the PT's own Free slots within the PT package term — a session cannot be moved past the package end date (BR-64, BR-40). The session stays Scheduled, is not deducted and does not count as a swap; a SessionMoveLogs row with MoveType \`PtReschedule\` is written. The target date must be one on which the customer (couple: at least one member) holds a valid membership package (CBR-61). ; it must be a day on which the customer still has a membership package.  |
| Transfer — new trainer | Required when this option is chosen: a dropdown of any PT who is free at that time, regardless of price. The session value is unchanged, and the commission goes to the new PT.  |
| Cancel — reason | Required wherever a business rule demands one: 5–500 characters, stored with the record and written to the audit log. . |
| Cancel — cash confirmation | A checkbox that must be ticked before saving, confirming the customer has agreed to be refunded in cash. The session becomes Cancelled but is still consumed and still earns commission.  |
| Reschedule at the customer's request — new slot | Required when this option is chosen: a dropdown used for customers without an account. It counts against the swap allowance of the package (at most three) but, unlike a self-service swap, may fall on any weekday and in any week.  |
| Guardian phone verification | Required before acting on behalf of a Dependent profile: exactly 10 digits, starting with 0, and must match a guardian phone number stored on the profile.  |

 

**Screen-level notes:**

•  	Only the PT in charge may act, and only while the session is Scheduled and has not started.

• The option to reschedule, transfer or cancel a session is The options to reschedule, transfer or cancel are available for any Scheduled session of the PT in charge until the session starts (BR-69, BR-70); after the start time they are hidden. , since the session hasn't reached that window yet. 

•  	Every option notifies the customer immediately, and a transfer also notifies the new PT; a Dependent profile receives no in-system notification.

•  	Once the attendance window has passed, the system closes the session itself: Completed if the customer checked in that day, otherwise Missed; a session on a day without a membership package is always Missed.

•  	The screen must work on a phone.
